title: Accountant - Immediate Joiner
description:
Position Title: Accountant
 



  





 Location: Bhayander West
 



 Experience: Minimum 6 Months
 



 Qualification: B.Com or any Accounting\-related degree
 



  





 Job Summary
 



  





 We are looking for an Accountant with hands\-on experience in a CA firm to support accounting, taxation, GST and compliance activities. The candidate will be responsible for accounting entries and data management on Tally, assisting with GST calculations and filings, Income Tax return preparation, and audit\-related activities.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Handle accounting entries and financial data management using Tally.
 



 Assist with GST calculations, filings, reconciliations and related compliance activities.
 



 Support Income Tax return preparation and other Income Tax compliance tasks.
 



 Maintain and organize accounting and compliance\-related records.
 



 Assist the team with audit\-related activities under guidance.
 



 Ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting and compliance data.
 



 Coordinate with the internal team for accounting, taxation and client\-related requirements.
 



 Required Skills and Qualifications
 



 Minimum 6 months of experience in a CA firm is mandatory.
 



 B.Com or any Accounting\-related degree.
 



 Hands\-on knowledge of Tally and accounting entries.
 



 Practical understanding of GST calculations, filings and reconciliations.
 



 Exposure to Income Tax return preparation and compliance.
 



 Basic understanding of audit\-related activities.
 



 Good knowledge of MS Excel and accounting data management.
 



 Good communication, attention to detail and willingness to learn.
 



  





 Perks \& Benefits
 



 15–20% increment every 6 months
 



 Salary as per industry standards
 



 Comp Off
 



 Bonus
